QUALITY.TITLE: Quality you can see
QUALITY.INTRO: Not a marketing claim, verified live, right here on the page.
QUALITY.A11Y_TEXT: Simulate a vision impairment and see for yourself: content stays readable and usable.
QUALITY.A11Y_MOCK_TITLE: Websites that work for your business.
QUALITY.A11Y_INFO_TEXT: Each filter changes colors the way a person with that impairment would perceive them, from red-green and blue-yellow color blindness to severe vision impairment (grayscale). This shows whether content stays distinguishable and usable even without full color perception.
QUALITY.SPEED_TEXT: Not a marketing figure, measured directly in your browser, right now.
QUALITY.SPEED_FOOTNOTE: Measured via your browser's Navigation Timing API, freshly on every visit.
QUALITY.SPEED_INFO_TITLE: Why is this faster than WordPress?
QUALITY.SPEED_INFO_TEXT: WordPress rebuilds every page on every visit: PHP runs, the database gets queried, often dozens of plugins and a theme load, that takes time. This site, by contrast, is pre-compiled: a lean, ready-to-go Angular bundle, no database query, no plugin overhead. The browser only has to display it, not assemble it.
QUALITY.WCAG_TEXT: Keyboard navigation and color contrast, test it yourself, don't just take our word for it.
QUALITY.WCAG_TAB_HINT: Press Tab to move through the fields, focus always stays visible.
QUALITY.WCAG_INFO_TEXT: Press Tab to move through the boxes, the visible focus ring proves the site is usable without a mouse. For color contrast, the site calculates the real contrast ratio of your chosen colors live, using the official WCAG formula, and checks whether it meets the minimum of 4.5:1 for text.
QUALITY.PRIVACY_TEXT: Swiss data protection law (nDPA) and EU GDPR, considered from day one, not bolted on afterwards.
QUALITY.PRIVACY_POINT_1: Server location for the best possible protection, e.g. Switzerland or the EU
QUALITY.PRIVACY_POINT_2: Fonts hosted locally, not loaded from external servers
QUALITY.PRIVACY_POINT_3: Data minimisation from the ground up
QUALITY.PRIVACY_POINT_4: Contact form runs on a self-written script, no third-party form API
QUALITY.PRIVACY_INFO_TITLE: Why does this matter, and for whom?
QUALITY.PRIVACY_INFO_TEXT: GDPR and Swiss nDPA apply based on the destination principle: what matters is where your customers are, not where the server sits. Server location doesn't change which law applies. What it does affect is transferring data abroad: servers in the US are also subject to US laws like the CLOUD Act, which can allow US authorities access, and require extra safeguards (e.g. standard contractual clauses). Servers in Switzerland or the EU avoid that complexity. That's why I choose the location together with you, based on your customer base and your needs. Regardless of location, one rule always applies: your customers and website visitors need to know what happens to their data, clearly, not buried in fine print.
QUALITY.DOMAIN_TEXT: Your domain is often the first impression, more important than most people think.
QUALITY.DOMAIN_POINT_4: A proper email address instead of @gmail.com looks more professional
QUALITY.DOMAIN_FOOTNOTE: I'll advise you on the choice before you register anything.

PRIVACY_POLICY.TITLE: Privacy Policy
PRIVACY_POLICY.CONTROLLER_TEXT: Andreas Kissner, Rue du Champ fort 6, 2853 Courfaivre, Switzerland. Email: developer@andreas-kissner.cloud, phone: +41 76 749 67 13. Andreas Kissner is responsible for processing your personal data on this website under the Swiss Federal Act on Data Protection (nDPA).
PRIVACY_POLICY.PRINCIPLES_TEXT: This website only collects the data necessary to run it and to handle your requests. Without your consent, no data is processed for analytics or marketing purposes.
PRIVACY_POLICY.HOSTING_TEXT: This website is hosted with IONOS in Germany, within the EU. When you visit the site, the hosting provider automatically processes technical access data (e.g. IP address, date and time of access, page requested, browser used), as is technically necessary for any web hosting. This data serves the security and stable operation of the website.
PRIVACY_POLICY.DATA_TEXT: Beyond the technical access data logged by hosting, this website does not collect any further data without your consent, in particular no analytics or tracking scripts. We only collect personal data you actively provide, for example via the contact form.
PRIVACY_POLICY.CONTACT_FORM_TEXT: When you use the contact form, your name, email address and message are processed via a self-written script, not a third-party form API. A hidden honeypot field helps detect automated spam. Your details are used solely to handle your request, are not shared with third parties, and are kept only as long as needed to answer you.
PRIVACY_POLICY.COOKIES_TEXT: This website uses Google Analytics 4 to measure traffic, but only if you accept in the cookie banner. Without your consent, no analytics cookie is set and no connection to Google Analytics is made. If you accept, Google Analytics sets, among others, the "_ga" cookie to recognise repeat visits. Processing is carried out by Google, which may use servers outside Switzerland and the EU, in particular in the US, safeguarded by the Swiss-US Data Privacy Framework, under which Google is certified. Google retains this data for 14 months by default, unless configured otherwise. You can change your decision at any time using the button below; declining immediately deletes the analytics cookie.
PRIVACY_POLICY.RIGHTS_TEXT: You have the right to access the personal data we process about you, and to request its correction, deletion or restriction of processing. You may also object to processing and, where applicable, request your data in a common format. Please contact the address given above. You may also contact the Federal Data Protection and Information Commissioner (FDPIC).
PRIVACY_POLICY.CHANGES_TEXT: This privacy policy may be updated, for example when this website gains new features or legal requirements change. The version currently published on this page is the one that applies.

COOKIE_BANNER.TITLE: Cookies
COOKIE_BANNER.TEXT: We optionally use Google Analytics to understand how this website is used. Only with your consent.
COOKIE_BANNER.INFO_TITLE: What are cookies, and why are we asking?
COOKIE_BANNER.INFO_TEXT: Cookies are small files a website stores in your browser. This site doesn't need them for anything else, the only reason for this question is Google Analytics: it lets me see how many people visit and which content they're interested in. If you accept, a cookie is set for that. If you decline, nothing changes technically, the site works exactly the same, I just won't see any visitor numbers. So there's no downside for you in declining.
